timing_contract: One hourly origin: first native observation within first15min. Forecast nominal1hour, score nearest native target within5min, same calendar day, no interpolation. Causal lag<=origin−1hour within15min. Latest20percent native dates per stream reserved. Native response outliers retained.
calibration: T and Te are current internal/external Celsius temperatures; T−1 is a causal one-hour lag, He is current external relative humidity percent, and v is external vapor-pressure deficit in kPa. Five offsets c_s are−0.384543,−0.316614,−0.340834,+0.138741,+0.323654degC in rules.json sensor order. Coefficients ba=−0.002878, br=0.050874, bm=0.083403 are dimensionless; bv=0.481876degC/kPa and bvr=0.084243/kPa. The reference30degC is an algebraic centering constant, not a prescribed biological setpoint.
independent_unit: future native-date block per calibrated sensor stream

challenger.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the radiative branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_newton.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the newton branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_persistence.equation: y=link^{-1}(base(X)+sum_j beta_j phi_j(X)); exact feature terms and link are the persistence branch in run.py::basis, and all hyperparameters/category calibration coefficients are in this model state.

baseline_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

baseline_residual_rbf.equation: Frozen Gaussian-kernel ridge: baseline(if residual)+intercept+sum_j w_j exp(-||train-standardized X-center_j||^2/(2 width^2)); all input scaling, categorical encoding, center arrays, coefficients, ridge and optional baseline state in rules.json.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared conditions, sensor/system dependence or small numbers of reserved groups do not support precise population-level confidence. No row-bootstrap intervals.

scope_limits: Latest native dates at five calibrated sensor streams from one apiary; sensor/colony, species and season are confounded. No unseen-apiary or colony-health prediction.

exposure.historical_record: All packaged targets are now exposed; future scoring is retrospective. Timestamp/input dictionaries examined; no future confirmation targets or score viewed before protocol freezing.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
